cards.name: Ad Winner #4
cards.hook: Would you believe me if I told you this was my makeup bag and I could do my face in under five minutes in the carpool line?
cards.angle: Speed and convenience: a full face in under 5 minutes, done in the car.
cards.persona: Busy mom in the school pickup line (TW persona tag: Busy moms).
cards.learning: Top spender and top seller of the account. The hook pairs a specific situation (carpool line) with a measurable promise (under 5 minutes), and the hands-only footage keeps the product on screen the whole time.
cards.next_iteration: Keep the carpool concept and test new first lines (H2, H3): a time stamp on screen, a before/after of the old makeup bag, or the clutter pain stated first.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 134 purchases at US$105.84 CPA, 1.62 ROAS

cards.name: New Ad #1
cards.hook: I just did my entire makeup look in five minutes on an airplane with this little kit.
cards.angle: Travel: full face in 5 minutes, even on a flight; replaces the big makeup bag.
cards.persona: Frequent traveler (TW persona tag: On the go travelers).
cards.learning: Native GRWM format with a strong setting (airplane) that proves the TSA and portability claims visually.
cards.next_iteration: Same footage with the question hook (became New Ad #3), and a shorter 25 to 30 s cut.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 99 purchases at US$115.87 CPA, 1.34 ROAS

cards.name: New Ad #5
cards.hook: Now I just grab this, everything I need in one compact on-the-go kit.
cards.angle: Declutter: one compact kit replaces the heavy makeup bag and 10 brushes.
cards.persona: Busy professional and traveler (TW persona tag: On the go travelers); script mentions late to a meeting.
cards.learning: Second best CPA among the big spenders (21% below account average). The problem is visible in frame 1 (the cluttered bag), so the viewer gets the contrast before any word lands.
cards.next_iteration: Iterate the opening visual (dump the old bag on a table) and test a stronger spoken hook on the same body.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 84 purchases at US$92.37 CPA, 1.60 ROAS

cards.name: FaceinaCase Static
cards.angle: Completeness: every product for a full face packed in one case.
cards.persona: On the go travelers (TW persona tag).
cards.learning: Best static of the account and the lowest CPA among the top 5 (24% below average). The same image also ran as Ad Winner #3 (31 more purchases at $87.74 CPA).
cards.next_iteration: Headline variants on the same layout ("Your whole makeup bag, in one case") and a version with a customer quote.
cards.alt: Trestique US static ad: 80 purchases at US$88.92 CPA, 1.61 ROAS

cards.name: Early Access IMG Ad #1
cards.angle: Urgency and discount: early Black Friday access.
cards.persona: Not tagged in TW; copy positions it as a gift ("perfect gift for busy...").
cards.learning: Simple offer static that sold 52 orders under the account CPA during the BFCM ramp-up.
cards.next_iteration: Pair the offer with the best evergreen hooks (5 minutes, carpool, airplane) instead of a pure promo layout.
cards.alt: Trestique US static ad: 52 purchases at US$101.27 CPA, 1.29 ROAS

cards.name: Ad Winner #6
cards.hook: Okay guys, I got ready in literally record time today.
cards.angle: Speed plus ease: full face in about 5 minutes, no color matching stress thanks to the shade quiz.
cards.persona: Busy mom on the go (TW persona: Busy moms +1).
cards.learning: Covers the main objection for makeup online (shade matching) with the quiz, on top of the speed promise.
cards.next_iteration: Open with the shade quiz as the hook ("I didn't have to guess my shade") and cut to 30 s.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 25 purchases at US$91.41 CPA, 1.61 ROAS

cards.name: New Ad #3
cards.hook: grwm on the airplane with Trestique
cards.angle: Travel: TSA proof kit, full face before take-off.
cards.persona: On the go travelers (TW persona tag).
cards.learning: Iteration of a validated concept: same footage, only the opening changed. CPA dropped from $115.87 (New Ad #1) to $91.09, 21% lower, on smaller spend.
cards.next_iteration: Scale test: move budget to this opening, then test the question line as the very first sentence.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 24 purchases at US$91.09 CPA, 1.66 ROAS

cards.name: 08.31 New Ad #1-Lae Andres @lae.andres
cards.hook: Let's see if I can do a full face of makeup in five minutes.
cards.angle: Speed challenge plus beginner friendly (no guessing shades, no digging for brushes).
cards.persona: On-the-go, newer to makeup (from the script; TW not tagged).
cards.learning: Highest CTR of the Trestique batch (2.27%): the challenge format makes people watch the outcome. Conversion was weaker (ROAS 1.12), so the click came from curiosity more than intent.
cards.next_iteration: Keep the challenge open, add a timer on screen, cut to 30 s and move the CTA earlier.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 15 purchases at US$114.17 CPA, 1.12 ROAS

cards.name: Michele Johnston | UGC Ad #3
cards.hook: I'm 50, my knee hurts when it rains and I would rather eat glass than spend 30 minutes putting my face on.
cards.angle: Simplicity for mature women: no 30-minute routine, everything in one pouch.
cards.persona: Mature women, 50+ (TW persona tag: Mature women).
cards.learning: A distinct persona (50+) with its own language. 15% under the account CPA on a test budget, which validates mature women as a segment.
cards.next_iteration: Build a mature-women pack: same hook structure with 2 or 3 more creators 45+, and statics using the "RIP to 45 step makeup routines" line.
cards.alt: Trestique US UGC video ad: 11 purchases at US$99.42 CPA, 1.35 ROAS

cards.name: 08.10 new testing - Ellen @lifeathomewithellen
cards.hook: If you're a busy mom who wants an easy makeup routine without having to be a makeup expert, this is for you.
cards.angle: Beginner friendly: no guesswork, five minutes before the kids wake up.
cards.persona: Busy mom, not a makeup expert (TW persona tag: Busy moms).
cards.learning: Best CPA of the Trestique batch: $74.63, 36% below the account average, and the best ROAS (1.78). All of its spend ($746.31) ran inside a creative testing campaign (07.16 | HLA | Creative Testing).
cards.next_iteration: Graduate it from testing to a scaling campaign (CT to CV) and brief 3 new hooks on the same body (H2 to H4).
